personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 3 Editorial Mobile typography
personality_one_liner: A premium, sophisticated furniture planning experience that feels like browsing a high-end interior design magazine.

spacing.rule: Maintain sophisticated, generous spacing for a premium feel. Do not cramp content. Follow iOS-native vertical rhythm.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky bottom CTA containers
Use glass overlay behind the bottom-sheet handles/headers
Apply subtle blur to product image backgrounds in the detail view
dont's: Do not apply glass to body text regions
Do not use glass on form inputs or dense data cards

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Introduce the app's value proposition and start the wizard.

states.error: Failed to load hero image, Retry button

screens.layout: Large hero image covering the top half with a gradient scrim. Display the headline 'Design a Home That Actually Fits.' in Fraunces. A sticky bottom container with a primary 'Start Planning' CTA button.

screens.name: Wizard_UploadFloorPlan
screens.purpose: Capture the user's room floor plan.

states.empty: A large dashed border upload zone with a camera/upload icon.

screens.layout: Top segmented progress indicator. Large card area for uploading/taking a photo of the floor plan. Bottom sticky CTA 'Next'.

screens.name: Wizard_ConfirmDimensions
screens.purpose: Allow user to verify or input room dimensions.

states.empty: Show input fields for Width and Length.

screens.layout: Display a simplified 2D SVG preview of the room. Form inputs with labels above them for dimensions. Bottom sticky CTA.

screens.name: Wizard_SelectFurniture
screens.purpose: Select which furniture items are needed.
screens.layout: Grid of rounded cards (surfaceSecondary) with icons and '+ / -' quantity steppers for items like Sofa, TV Stand, Rug, Coffee Table.

screens.name: Wizard_ChooseStyle
screens.purpose: Select the aesthetic style of the room.
screens.layout: Masonry grid or large vertical list of image cards representing styles (Japandi, Scandi, Mid-Century, Industrial). Each card must have a gradient scrim and the style name in white text overlaid at the bottom. The selected style gets a borderStrong highlight.

screens.name: Wizard_SetBudget
screens.purpose: Define the overall budget for the room.
screens.layout: Large typographic display of the total budget amount. A slider component below. A breakdown list showing how the budget will be allocated across categories.

screens.name: GenerateLayouts
screens.purpose: Show AI-generated floor plans based on previous inputs.

states.loading: Generating your perfect layouts... (Animated subtle loading state)

screens.layout: Horizontal scroll (carousel) of 2-3 interactive scaled 2D SVG floor plans. Below the carousel, a description of why this layout works. 'Choose This Layout' CTA.

screens.name: ShopYourRoom
screens.purpose: Interactive shopping experience mapped to the layout.
screens.layout: Top half: The selected 2D SVG layout. Tapping an item highlights it. Bottom half: A bottom sheet or list showing the specific product detail (Image, Title, Price, 'Swap Alternative' button). Real-time budget progress bar at the very top.

screens.name: FinalDashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of the finalized room and shopping list.
screens.layout: A scrollable dashboard. Section 1: Final Floor Plan thumbnail. Section 2: Budget Summary chart/metrics. Section 3: Vertical list of all selected products. Bottom sticky CTA to 'Export CSV' or 'Share'.

hero_home.alt: Beautiful minimal living room hero image

style_industrial.alt: Industrial style interior living room loft

style_scandinavian.alt: Scandinavian style interior room white and wood

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a clean, native-feeling stack navigation wizard. Avoid multiple tabs; keep it linear.
For the 'Choose Style' screen, ensure every image card has a dark vertical gradient scrim overlay (bottom 30-40%) to guarantee text readability.
All primary CTAs (like 'Next' or 'Start Planning') must be anchored to the bottom using a glassmorphic sticky container to avoid scrolling to find them.
Use the 'Fraunces' font for main page headers to evoke an editorial, Pinterest-like premium feel, and 'DM Sans' for all UI labels and body text.

SVG 2D Layouts: The generated SVG must be scalable and cleanly designed. When rendering the 'Shop Your Room' feature, use @gorhom/bottom-sheet to display interactive product alternatives without leaving the context of the floor plan.
The progress indicator must sit gracefully at the top of the wizard screens, utilizing a segmented bar design using 'brandPrimary' for completed steps.
Respect the 'surface' (Warm Ivory) as the main screen background and 'surfaceSecondary' (White) for floating cards to create subtle, premium depth.
